description: This file implements a native MSSQL driver and associated recordset classes for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It contains driver-specific methods for connection handling, query execution, transaction management, schema introspection, and data manipulation tailored to Microsoft SQL Server via the sqlsrv extension.

classes.name: ADODB_mssqlnative
classes.description: Main class implementing the MSSQL native driver, handling connection, query execution, schema info, and transactions.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssqlnative
classes.description: Class representing a recordset for MSSQL, with methods for navigation, data fetching, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_mssqlnative
classes.description: A specialized recordset class for array-based data, extending the base Array recordset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the driver, sets error handling, and configures logging based on the debug flag.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MSSQL server with given credentials using sqlsrv extension.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement, appending identity retrieval if needed, and manages last insert ID.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the active connection, rolling back transactions if necessary.

methods.name: ServerVersion
methods.description: Detects the MSSQL server version and validates support.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server description and version information.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves and formats error messages from sqlsrv.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last SQL error code.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index metadata for a table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Fetches foreign key constraints information.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Lists available databases.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Gets primary key columns for a table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Lists tables with optional filtering by type and name pattern.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns detailed column information for a table, with caching.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Generates SQL for substring operation tailored to MSSQL syntax.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates BLOB or CLOB data in a table.

methods.name: offsetDate
methods.description: Creates SQL for adding days or fractions thereof to a date.
